summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Forlanini, a district of Milan, Italy. It states that Forlanini is a quartiere located east of the city centre and that it belongs to the Zone 4 administrative division.
one_line: Forlanini is a district of Milan, Italy, located east of the city centre within Zone 4.
key_facts: Forlanini is a district ("quartiere") of Milan, Italy.
Forlanini is part of the Zone 4 administrative division of Milan.
Forlanini is located east of the city centre of Milan.

entities.name: Forlanini
entities.role: district (quartiere) of Milan, Italy, located east of the city centre

entities.name: Milan
entities.role: city in Italy containing the Forlanini district

entities.name: Zone 4
entities.role: administrative division of Milan of which Forlanini is a part
